item.title: What Did the Bye Week Provide? Texans HC DeMeco Ryans and TE Coach James Ferentz on Texans All-Access
item.description:
The Texans are on their bye, but Texans All-Access isn't. John Harris and Marc Vandermeer open Friday's show on 95.7 The Fan with the strange feel of a weekend without a game. They also look at whether London travel played a part in the loss to the Giants and why the Chargers, Browns and Colts stretch could still flip the season.
Tight ends coach James Ferentz makes his first studio visit. The former Texans offensive lineman describes the path from a warehouse job to a decade-long playing career and two Super Bowl rings. He explains how a Bill Belichick assignment to develop a young center gave him the coaching bug, and what makes the Texans room of Dalton Schultz, Foster Moreau, Cade Stover, Brevin Jordan and rookie Marlin Klein special.
Plus, Ka'imi Fairbairn tells former Texans CB Johnathan Joseph what was going through his mind before the game-winner in London. Head coach DeMeco Ryans closes the show on Feel Good Friday. He covers the bye week self-scout, Tank Dell's return and his message to rookies. He also explains why the Texans believe a run is still possible over the final 10 games.
